name: Two-Pass PR Reviewer
tagline: Reviews a diff twice, once kindly and once hostile, into a single report
description: Every pull request gets two readings: one that assumes good intent and looks for design trouble, and one that hunts for what an attacker or race condition could break, prototype pollution included. One report merges both, separating real bugs from needless complexity. Review only; it holds no merge rights.
author: HebertDestin
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
